title: 第9章  龙象般若功第10章  二伯苏锦
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
【观想老翁钓龙图，吸收一缕玄黄气，三缕龙鲸气。】
【玄黄气：高等精气，蕴含上乘武道至理。】
【适用武学：玄黄擒龙大手（二阶上品武学，当前创武进度：30%）】
【龙鲸气：中等精气，蕴含龙属生物神通感悟。】
【适用武学：龙象般若功（一阶极品武学，当前创武进度76%）】
······
“玄黄擒龙大手？龙象般若功！”
意识从挂历中回转之后，苏青揉着眉心，休息许久，才眼神一亮的去书桌上翻箱倒柜起来。
在一叠【初级经脉学】，【人体密藏论】，【外家拳精要】，【内家功禁忌】等课本下面。
翻出了他这些年的创武积累。
龙象般若功。
降龙十八掌。
三分归元气。
六脉神剑。
万剑归宗。
阴阳合欢大悲奏。
天地不老长春功。
······
这些武学，都是他根据前世记忆写下来的。
大多数都只写了武学理念跟武学效果。

没写具体的练法。
这也没法写，前世那些写小说的，光知道怎么吹，谁知道怎么练？
唯一写满了笔记的，只有两门武学。
一门是他尝试开创的第一门武学。
龙象般若功！
这门武学能全方位增幅身体素质。
且前期修行简单，尤其是适合他这样底子弱的人打基础用。
这些年来，为补全这门武学，他看过佛经，研究过道经，学过密宗禅理，修过内功精要。
集毕生之所学，也还没创出头绪来。
只用了三成知识储备，却把另一门铁布衫捣鼓出来大概。
再经过铁牛阴差阳错练成之后，铁布衫倒成了他开创的第一门武学。
原本以为，这些前世的武学，到这方世界有些水土不服。
还得脚踏实地，慢慢摸索着创武。
没想到，在这武道印记这里，他记下的这些武学，都有创武进度！
“连神象镇狱劲都有5%的创武进度？
我可只写了“人体由八千四千个微粒组成”，这一句话而已！
而这门武学可是还在九阶武学之上的超脱级武学！”
他惊喜出声，坐下想了许久才明白大概原因。
“努力很重要，灵感更重要！
新颖的武学理念，玄奇的武学效果。

"Xuanhuang's dragon-capturing skill? Dragon-elephant Prajna Kung Fu!"
After regaining consciousness from the calendar, Su Qing rubbed the center of her brows and rested for a long time before going to the desk to rummage through the cabinets with bright eyes.
Under a stack of textbooks such as "Elementary Meridians", "Treatise on Secrets of the Human Body", "Essences of External Boxing", "Taboos of Internal Skills", etc.
He uncovered his accumulated martial arts achievements over the years.
Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu.
The Eighteen Palms of Subduing the Dragon.
Three points return to vitality.
Six Meridians Divine Sword.
Wan Jian returns to his clan.
The yin and yang rejoice and the great tragedy plays.
The eternal spring power of immortality in heaven and earth.
······
These martial arts were all written down by him based on his memories of previous lives.
Most of them only write about martial arts concepts and martial arts effects.
No specific training methods were written.
There is no way to write this. Those who wrote novels in the previous life only knew how to brag, but who knew how to practice?
The only ones filled with notes were two martial arts.
One is the first martial arts he tried to create.
Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu!
This martial art can increase physical fitness in all aspects.
Moreover, the early practice is simple, especially suitable for people with weak foundation like him to lay the foundation.
Over the years, in order to complete this martial arts, he has read Buddhist scriptures, studied Taoist scriptures, learned Tantric Zen principles, and practiced the essence of internal strength.
I have gathered all my life’s knowledge and still haven’t come up with a clue yet.
Only 30% of the knowledge reserve was used, but another iron cloth shirt was roughly figured out.
After being trained by Tie Niu by mistake, Tie Bu Shi became the first martial art he created.
I originally thought that these martial arts skills from previous lives would be a little acclimated to this world.
You still have to keep your feet on the ground and slowly explore to create martial arts.
Unexpectedly, in this martial arts mark, the martial arts he wrote down all have progress in martial arts creation!
"Even the divine elephant's prison-suppressing power has 5% martial arts progress?
I only wrote "The human body is composed of 8,400 particles", that's all!
And this martial arts is a transcendent level martial arts that is still above the ninth level martial arts! "
He cried out in surprise, sat down and thought for a long time before he understood the general reason.
“Effort is important, inspiration is even more important!
Novel martial arts concepts and mysterious martial arts effects.
